name: Goldene Krone
beschreibung:
Situated right by Innsbruck's famous Triumphal Arch (Triumphpforte), Hotel Goldene Krone provides stylish rooms and friendly service. It serves as an ideal base for exploring the city's sights on foot.

The historic Old Town, the Golden Roof, the Maria-Theresien-Strasse shopping avenue, and the main station are just a short stroll away.
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Hotel Goldene Krone in Innsbruck offers central convenience facing the historic Triumphal Arch.
